text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell Mihono Bourbon about our plans
regarding
training and promo concerts
leading up to the
Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello described the Grand Concert
as a
stage for runners to convey their
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's why, if Bourbon's going to perform, I want her to do it because she wants to, not because I "order" her to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If there ever comes a day when she
wants to
perform of her own volition,
then we'll talk about
getting her up on
stage.
